name: sleek
description: Connects Claude to Sleek (sleek.design), an AI mobile app design tool, over the network through Sleek's remote MCP server at https://sleek.design/api/mcp. You sign in to your own Sleek account with OAuth, or configure an API key. The tools let Claude list, create, fetch, and permanently delete your Sleek projects; list the screens in a project and fetch a screen's HTML; list Sleek's curated design references; run Sleek's design agent to create or edit screens from a plain-language brief; check or cancel a design run; and render up to four screens to an image. Design runs spend your Sleek workspace's AI credits. Listing, reading, and rendering are free. Free accounts get one-time trial credits (about one design run); sustained use requires a paid Sleek plan (Pro or higher). The plugin contains only this server definition: no hooks, skills, agents, commands, or telemetry. The only network destinations are sleek.design and its OAuth authorization server (a supabase.co host).
